title: Validated circuit construction
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a list of gates, and an output index, return the circuit with those gates and output if every argument read by gate $i$ is less than $n+i$ and the output index is less than $n$ plus the number of gates. If either condition fails, return no circuit.
